title: The `nvs service` subcommand summaries are written in the repository's dense voice, not the plain one.
text: `nvs service --help` prints a doc comment per subcommand. `uninstall` reads "Take the registration away, leaving no key, …", `status` reads "Report the state the manager holds it in, and — over the control socket …", and `stop` reads "Ask it to stop, which a hosted server answers with a drain". An end user reads these, and they break the plain-voice bounds `AGENTS.md` § *Text an end user reads* sets: a dash joins two ideas, and the subject is not the command. Goal `plain-comments` swept `.nvs` comments and `about.md`, not command-line help. Closing this rewrites the `Service` enum's doc comments in that voice, and any help snapshot test that reads them.
